title: The Birth of Isaac and the Sending Away of Hagar
description: Sarah gives birth to Isaac in her old age, just as the Lord had promised, and Abraham circumcises him. Later, Sarah demands that Hagar and Ishmael be sent away, and God promises to make Ishmael into a great nation too.
